# Done

Closed roadmap items, newest first: what shipped and what was measured and
**declined**. A declined idea often leaves no other trace, so this is the only
place its reasoning survives. **Search this before proposing work**, then open
only the matching entry under [`archive/`](archive/).

This index is generated by `node bin/roadmap.js`. The entries it links to are
append-only. See [`README.md`](README.md).
